title: A Dynamic Graph Fusion Model for Ultra-Short-Term Wind Farm Turbine-Level Wind Power Forecasting
content: Accurate ultra-short-term wind power forecasting at the turbine level is important for grid stability and dispatching. To address the time-varying spatial and temporal correlations among multiple turbines in a single wind farm, this paper builds dynamic spatio-temporal graphs to model dynamic spatial dependencies, proposes a causal dilated convolutional network to combine short-term and long-term dependencies, proposes a graph fusion layer to achieve weight fusion of different graph sources. Experiments show that GraphFusionGRU achieves the lowest error, outperforming compared baseline models. The results confirm the model’s improved robustness, and interpretability for complex wind farm environments.
